Subject: Recap + next steps: Stratus Health trial - capacity and success criteria

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth before Rafael scopes infra and Marissa prepares onboarding.

High-level objective
- Run a 3-week trial to validate model quality and unit economics for Stratus Health’s clinical summarization flow (batch and near-real-time chat).

Success criteria (proposal)
- Latency: 95th %-ile generation latency <= 350ms for chat path under steady-state (per small request).
- Throughput: sustain 1200 small-chat requests / minute (burst to 3000/min tolerated for 2–3 minute windows).
- Quality: ROUGE-L improvement >= 12% over current baseline on the clinical-summary eval set.
- Cost target: keep inference token cost <= $0.003 per 1k tokens for the trial workload (including autoscaling).

POC evaluation plan
- Stratus to provide a representative eval set (anonymized) and a 48-hour synthetic replay (timeline below).
- Redwood to run a smoke test, then an 8-hour full replay and a 72-hour mixed-traffic soak.
- Measure: latency histogram, token costs, per-model accuracy on eval prompts, and cache hit rates.

Capacity / infra ask (initial)
- Reserve: 2 x A100-class GPUs for baseline (dedicated) during the first week.
- Autoscale: policy up to 6 GPUs for sustained load, with burst to 10 GPUs for transient spikes (max 3 minutes) — Rafael will validate whether a mix of 2x A100 + T4s is better for cost.
- KV cache: persistent within the trial cluster for warm prefixes; recommend 12GB of KV allocation per GPU for this workload.

Ownership & next steps
- Camila (AE): coordinate kickoff and commercial approvals; confirm final dates.
- Rafael (Solutions): scope exact GPU SKU mix, batching config, and pricing estimate by EOD Thu (2026-02-12).
- Marissa (CS): prep onboarding checklist and success-metrics worksheet; will own the trial runbook and weekly cadence.
- Alyssa / Stratus: share anonymized eval set + replay schedule; confirm SOC 2 evidence point contacts if needed.

Attached: trial-success-criteria-template.xlsx (sheet with metric definitions + scoring).

Hi all — ran a quick sizing pass based on the described workload (clinical summarization + chat). Notes below and a small config attached (redwood-infra-config.yaml).

Recommended baseline
- Reserve: 2 x A10/A100 equivalent (we'll confirm exact SKU by region) as dedicated for the POC baseline. This supports warm KV cache and low-latency chat.
- Autoscaling policy: scale stepwise -> 4 GPUs at 60% CPU/GPU utilization, 6 GPUs at 85% utilization. Burst policy allows up to 10 GPUs for 3 minutes with a cooldown of 5 minutes.

Performance expectations (approx)
- Small-chat requests (avg 80 tokens output): 95th %-ile latency ~ 240-320ms when KV cache warm and batching configured (batch target: 64 tokens/window, max batch delay 15ms).
- Replay throughput: with 6 GPUs we expect ~2200 small-chat requests/min sustained in our lab tests.
- Cost estimate (trial): incremental infra cost estimate $3,400 - $4,800 over 3 weeks depending on burst usage and reserved SKU. Detailed numbers in the attached config.

Operational guidance
- KV cache persistence is supported within the same trial cluster (we'll pin the cluster). Cache will survive pod restarts as long as PV is attached; we recommend a persistent volume for KV store.
- Cold-start: additional replicas can start in ~6-12s depending on model variant and region; we can pre-warm during expected peak windows to keep cold-starts <5s in practice.

Next steps from infra side
- I’ll post a short infra playbook + pricing table by Mon EOD (2026-02-16).
- If Stratus can provide replay schedule Fri 14 Feb, Rafael will run an initial smoke and report results.

— Rafael Mendes
